remarks: Experience the charm of Silvermine Riverfront living. This first floor ranch style condo offers effortless one level living in a beautifully updated setting. This 2 bedroom, 1.5 bath home features a stylish kitchen with stainless steel appliances and refreshed bathrooms, including a sleek walk in shower. The open layout flows seamlessly from the living and dining areas into the kitchen with bar seating, creating a perfect space for both relaxing and entertaining. The bedrooms are generously sized with abundant closet space and additional storage, plus a private storage unit in the basement. Step outside to your own deck overlooking the tranquil river, a perfect spot to unwind and recharge. Complete with in unit laundry and a pet friendly setting, this home offers comfort, convenience, and a lifestyle you will love.
